content.text:
The tests failed because of an off-by-one error in `src/offset.js`. Pages are numbered from 1 (the tests expect `pageOf(1)` to return the newest issues), but `offset` calculated `page * perPage`, which treats page numbers as starting at 0. So page 1 skipped the first five issues and page 3 came back empty.

I changed it to `(page - 1) * perPage`. `page.js` is the only place that uses `offset`, so nothing else is affected. All 4 tests now pass. I haven't committed the change.
